translation:
Trong <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> và <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> được tăng {2} Crit. DMG và liên tục hút mục tiêu gần đó trong khi tích năng.
<size=10></size>
Khi Aemeath duy trì trạng thái đáp ứng tất cả các điều kiện sau trong hơn {1} giây, cô sẽ bước vào <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color>:
- Không trong trạng thái chiến đấu;
- Không thực hiện <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> hoặc Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Instant Response: Brilliance</color> kế thừa tất cả hiệu ứng của <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> và vẫn duy trì ngay cả khi vượt khỏi thời hạn của <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>.
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color> và không trong <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>, sử dụng <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> sẽ nhận được {5} điểm <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
Trong <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, khi Aemeath tiêu diệt mục tiêu bị ảnh hưởng bởi <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, cô sẽ bước vào trạng thái <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> trong {3} giây.
Khi ở trạng thái <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color>, Aemeath ghi nhận số tầng tối đa của <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> từ mục tiêu bị tiêu diệt.
Kỹ năng tiếp theo gây sát thương trực tiếp lên mục tiêu sẽ ngay lập tức áp đặt số tầng đã ghi nhận của <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, tối đa bằng giới hạn hiện tại của <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>. Hiệu ứng này kết thúc <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> và Aemeath không thể bước vào <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> hoặc <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> trong {4} giây.
source_en:
In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> gain {2} Crit. DMG increase and continuously pull in nearby target while charging.
<size=10></size>
When Aemeath remains in a state that meets all of the following conditions for over {1}s, she enters <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color>:
- Out of combat;
- Not performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Instant Response: Brilliance</color> inherits all effects of <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and remains active even when out of the duration of <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>. 
When in <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color> and not in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> grants {5} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Aemeath defeats a target affected by <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, she enters <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {3}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color>, Aemeath records the highest stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> among the targets defeated.
Her next skill that directly damages the target immediately inflicts the targets with the recorded stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, up to the current max limit of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>. This ends <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> and Aemeath cannot enter <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {4}s.

translation:

source_en:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Sundering Strike</color> is increased by {0}.
If Concerto Energy is full when not in the Inksplash of Mind state, Qiuyuan's <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain</color>, available once every 20s.
Upon casting <color=Highlight>Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain</color>, the <color=Highlight>Quietude Within</color> effect immediately ends and {1} Concerto Energy is consumed to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> equal to {3} of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG, and restore {2} points of <te href=141101>Swordster's Soliloquy</te>. Upon casting <color=Highlight>Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain</color>, Qiuyuan cannot gain the <color=Highlight>Quietude Within</color> effect the next time he enters <te href=141102>Inksplash of Mind</te>. <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach</color>, <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save</color>, and <color=Highlight>Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice</color> gain {4} DMG Multiplier increase and additionally restore <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Concerto Energy on hit.
When not in Co-op mode, upon casting <color=Highlight>Straw Cape in Drizzly Rain</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> is replaced with Outro Skill <color=Highlight>Sheath Fallen, New Shoots Revealed</color>, which deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> equal to {6} of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered Echo Skill DMG.
